1922708082/90HX-Studio.body:
# 90HX Studio

An unlock and tuning tool for the CMP 90HX (GA102). It unlocks graphics, compute, and ray tracing together, and includes GPU identity spoofing, in-game overlay unlocking, DLSS 3 frame generation, and dual-GPU scheduling. It is a single file that needs no installation: double-click to run.

## Features

- **Unlock**: NVPermissiveEFI approach, enabling graphics / compute / ray tracing together. Runs directly from the EFI Shell, deploys a separate boot entry without touching the Windows bootloader, and falls back automatically on failure. Three boot channels are available: modern UEFI direct boot, legacy motherboard Shell, and USB direct boot.
- **GPU spoofing**: Presents the 90HX as an RTX 3080. It modifies the registry, INF driver files, and NVIDIA App cache together. The driver hot-reloads, so changes take effect without rebooting the PC. The original factory name can be restored at any time.
- **In-game overlay**: Bypasses the NVIDIA App allowlist, unlocking the Alt+R performance overlay and ShadowPlay recording.
- **DLSS 3 frame generation**: Forces DLSS-G on SM86 GPUs, with support for the RE Engine framework. It includes 4 mirror routes, and updating the runtime library automatically selects the fastest one.
- **Dual-GPU scheduling**: iGPU display output with 90HX rendering. One click binds the high-performance GPU to AAA games.

The interface is cockpit-style: dual-ring sensor gauges, a live log, and quick actions are all at hand, so you don't have to switch pages to check the log while an unlock is running.

## Download

Get `90HX-Studio-v4.1.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/1922708082/90HX-Studio/blob/HEAD/../../releases/latest), then double-click to run. Nothing needs to be installed; it requests administrator privileges on its own.

If GitHub access is slow, use a mirror accelerator.

## Usage

1. Open the app, choose a boot channel on the '90HX Unlock' page, and click 'Run new-version unlock'
2. Fully shut down and power on again (shut down, not restart), then confirm that PCIe is running at Gen2 x16
3. On the 'GPU model spoofing' page, spoof the card as an RTX 3080 in one click
4. In-game, press Alt+R to view live frame rate and temperature, and Alt+Z to start recording

All operations support one-click restore, so mistakes can be undone.

Pure WPF + C# 5.0. Visual Studio is not required; the compiler that ships with the system is enough:

## Role-specific customization and version history

The same project experience may need different emphasis when applying for a frontend role versus a full-stack role. GResume derives independent copies from the base resume according to the job description (JD), preserving source and change records, so each role version is unaffected by the others. You can compare before and after edits, and restore from version history when a change doesn't work out.

Two kinds of relationships are distinguished here: which resume a role version was derived from, and which changes were made to the same resume over time. The former is recorded as a parent-child relationship; the latter stores document snapshots. When restoring, the snapshot is written back to the current document and a new restore record is added, so subsequent edits remain traceable.

The job tracker links roles to resumes and keeps interview rounds and next steps together, making it easier to prepare for interviews and track progress. The tracker links to the resume being continuously edited; to preserve the content as it was when you applied, use a [fixed share snapshot](#分享与审阅明确对外版本) or an exported file.

## Resume optimization: finding issues and fixing them one by one

A suggestion such as “project description is not specific” needs to point out which experience lacks what information, so it can be revised. The optimization system locates the issue in the original text, provides rationale and recommendations, and tracks progress. JD comparison checks gaps between experience and role requirements, and the ATS plain-text preview checks what machines can read.

The model may return suggestions that have no corresponding field. The system first determines the evaluation scope based on the filled-in content, then normalizes the format returned by the model, and validates issue locations and the types of replacement values, to avoid pointing to nonexistent sections or writing inappropriate data. Scores are an aid for review and do not represent the screening results of hiring systems.

## AI Agent: completing edits within the workspace

Having AI revise a resume usually requires first providing context, then pasting results back and checking them. GResume's Agent directly reads the resume, evaluation results, and job-search records in the workspace, and calls tools according to the task. Before writing, it shows a diff or operation summary; after confirmation, results can be viewed on the right-hand canvas. Whether experiences and figures are accurate still requires your own judgment.

Analysis depends on current data, and edit results affect the next decision, so tool execution results return to the conversation for the Agent to continue processing; the default maximum is 12 steps. Skills and reference materials needed for a task are loaded on demand, reducing unrelated content occupying context.

Streaming responses, tool execution, and user confirmation are not synchronized. Fragments must form complete arguments before execution, and resume field writes must pass type validation and confirmation. When a user stops the conversation, the cancellation signal propagates to tools and the confirmation flow, and is checked again before writing, preventing pending operations from continuing to write afterward; edits already completed are kept.

Model requests are proxied through the server, so keys never enter the browser. To handle retries and interrupted streams, quota is reserved by unique request ID and then settled based on actual delivery, avoiding duplicate deductions.

## Sharing and review: explicit external versions

After a resume is sent out, continued editing should not quietly change what the recipient sees. When sharing, the body and template are snapshotted together, separating the working copy from the external version. When an update is needed, explicitly publishing a new version lets the original link carry over. Links can be set with a password, an expiration date, and comment permissions, and you can view access counts and the most recent access time.

Review comments are marked directly on the original text, eliminating the need for screenshots and explanations of location. After the body is edited, old positions may point to a different sentence, so comments are isolated by version while saving the paragraph they belong to, the original text, and surrounding context. When migrating to a new version, comments are rebound only if there is a unique match; comments that cannot be determined are kept as pending reconnection. …

ChisaAlter/ChisaBot.body:
ChisaBot is developed based on the open-source code of [CopilotKit/OpenBot](https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot). It retains AG-UI, multi-BOT, tool permissions, and audit capabilities, and adds a Chinese interface, standalone web login, local session persistence, and the Magpie model catalog and BOT model selection. This branch can save sessions in your own PostgreSQL via `OPENBOT_RUNTIME_MODE=local`, without a CopilotKit Intelligence project. Models are connected by administrators and can be self-hosted models, compatible APIs, or a self-deployed [Magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) gateway. When using third-party models, inference is still handled by the selected model service.

## Screenshots

> The following screenshots come from a brand-new demo instance (demo account, demo bot, no real conversations).

### Web (server)

Light theme: the bot list is on the left, the conversation is in the middle, and the right column is the panel the bot created.

### PC client (Windows)

The ChisaBot PC is a borderless window. After opening, it goes directly to the ChisaBot on your server, with window buttons in the top right. On first run, fill in the server address on the local 'Log in to ChisaBot' page.

### Mobile

The conversation and panels in a mobile browser (390×844), and the login page of the Android client.

## Existing features

- **Chinese interface**: chat, BOT management, settings, and admin pages are localized into Chinese. The built-in Chinese tenant pack is located at `examples/zh-CN/`.
- **Web login**: login page, server-side sessions, and logout. An authentication gateway protects pages and APIs.
- **Local operation and persistence**: local run mode uses PostgreSQL to store conversations, so sessions can still be viewed after a restart.
- **Model configuration**: administrators configure the protocol, API address, keys, and deployment default model, and test connections. Keys are stored encrypted on the server.
- **Magpie model catalog**: reads the full list of models actually exposed by the gateway, preserves provider prefixes, and supports search and refresh.
- **Per-BOT model selection**: the chat input box and the BOT settings modify the same persisted value. They stay in sync with each other and across browser tabs, and the next turn uses the new model.
- **Tools and permissions**: inherits upstream AG-UI integration, BOT computer, MCP tools, approvals, and auditing, enabled through deployment configuration.
- **Panels and cloud browser**: bots can create panels in the right column (optionally refreshed on a schedule), and can open and operate web pages in a cloud browser on the server. Switch between 'Panels | Computer' in the right column to view them.
- **Clients and online updates**: the Windows PC (Electron) and Android clients connect to your own server. The server updates with one click under 'Admin console → System update', and the web app and clients each prompt for new versions.

# TG Monitor

TG Monitor is a web management system for monitoring Telegram channel resources, governing cloud-drive links, and operating resource transfers. The project has been migrated to the `FastAPI + React/Vite + PostgreSQL` architecture. Day-to-day use is mainly through the browser UI; the legacy Streamlit pages are no longer part of the current deployment scheme.

## Current Form

- Backend: FastAPI provides the API; SQLAlchemy accesses PostgreSQL
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite, providing a complete admin interface
- Monitoring: Telethon continuously listens to Telegram channel messages and stores them in the database
- Worker: handles link inspection, transfer queues, update-tracking tasks, publishing rules, and log cleanup
- Deployment: supports local systemd services, and also retains Docker / Compose configuration

Day-to-day administration generally does not require running management commands. Channel management, link checks, AI configuration, resource operations, transfer tasks, backups, and system settings are all done in the UI. Commands are mainly used for initial setup, development startup, service deployment, backup and restore, and troubleshooting.

## Main Features

- Telegram channel message monitoring, parsing, search, filtering, pagination, and detail viewing
- Parsing of links from mainstream cloud drives including Alibaba Cloud Drive, Baidu Netdisk, Quark, Tianyi, 115, 123, UC, Xunlei, and others
- Public guest panel, login entry, admin backend, and access permission control
- Statistics, data analysis, trend charts, and resource distribution overview
- Channel management, system configuration, account policies, concurrency limits, and security settings
- Link deduplication, link inspection, dead-link detection, batch maintenance, and runtime log viewing
- AI Center: AI providers, model routing, recognition tasks, and business scenario configuration
- Resource operations: resource recognition, candidate resources, workbench, value assessment, and manual review
- Transfer center: cloud-drive accounts, manual transfers, batch queues, transfer logs, publishing records, and publishing rules
- Update-tracking tasks: automatic incremental checks, candidate assessment, file diagnostics, directory reuse, and original/new link status checks
- Backup management: database backups, restore entry points, and backup file management
- Background Worker automatically executes the task queue and periodically cleans up transfer/AI execution logs

## Project Structure

```text

├── app/
│   ├── api/              # FastAPI routes and runtime interfaces
```

Simplified Chinese | [Traditional Chinese](https://github.com/Toufff/zhaohuo-system/blob/HEAD/README.zh-Hant.md) | [English](https://github.com/Toufff/zhaohuo-system/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | [Korean](https://github.com/Toufff/zhaohuo-system/blob/HEAD/README.ko.md)

An in-game trainer for *Legend of Mortal* (Legend of Mortal), running as a BepInEx plugin. Press F8 in-game to open the panel, where you can:
- View which events this action may trigger, and choose which one to trigger;
- Directly edit attributes and affection;
- Preview the outcomes of dialogue options ahead of time;
- Choose dice roll results;
- Enable god mode and one-hit kills in combat.

The mod UI follows the game language and supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

- **Events**: Before each action, the panel lists events that may trigger on this action and their trigger conditions. Conditions include the current value (e.g., "Action count 3>=1"); satisfied conditions are shown in green. Under each event, the resulting changes to attributes, affection, etc. are listed, with increases in green and decreases in red. Triggerable events are listed first.
  - When an action pauses, select an event in the list and click "Continue this action" to trigger it this time. If none is selected, the action behaves as in the original game, with random results.
  - If a condition is just short of being met, click "Set to N" next to it to change the value directly so it is satisfied.
  - When an action pauses and this action had an event specified last time, click "Repeat last selection" to re-select the same event in one click.
- **Map**: Locations show how many events they have, and the marker turns green when there is a triggerable event. Hovering the mouse shows the event list. The settings page can turn off the event count on the map separately, while other hints still display. The panel's "Current map" section also has a "No specific location" group listing quests that are not attached to any location, along with their conditions.

- **One-time event reminders**: Each location on the map, as well as dialogue options (such as route choices on the road), that has an event available now which triggers only once, is marked green, and the option gets a green "●" in front.

> 💡 This module aims to integrate the [Nezha Monitoring client (nezha-agent)](https://github.com/nezhahq/agent) into the Android system as a Magisk module, enabling continuous background operation. All code and documentation in this repository were completed with the assistance of Gemini.

*   🔄 **Automatic sync**: Powered by GitHub Actions, periodically pulls the latest official core release and packages it.
*   ⚡ **Basic daemon**: Built-in daemon script with fault-tolerant network detection, retry mechanism for abnormal exits, and customizable power management modes.

## ✅ Usage

1. Go to the **[Releases page]** of this repository and download the latest version's archive (e.g. `magisk-nezha-agent-vX.X.X.zip`);
2. Extract the archive and edit the `/bin/config.yml` configuration file, filling in your panel communication address, secret key, and other probe information;
3. (Optional) Edit the `service.sh` file and configure the `RUN_MODE` variable according to the device's purpose to select a suitable sleep strategy;
4. Repackage all modified files into a ZIP (make sure to keep the original directory structure);
5. Flash the module via Magisk / KernelSU / APatch or similar tools;
6. Restart the device; the probe will run automatically in the background.

> 💡 **Tip**: The probe core has a built-in auto-update mechanism. As long as auto-update is not disabled in config.yaml, you only need to flash the module once.

guaner-334/civ-atlas.body:
Generate a complete planet in the browser and simulate its history: use plate tectonics, river erosion, climate, and ocean currents to compute terrain and ecology, then simulate peoples, states, wars, and dynastic changes, yielding an editable map and chronicle. Aimed at original worldbuilding for novels, setting bibles, tabletop RPGs, and similar creative work.

**[Try it online](https://atlas.gerdor.top)** | [Roadmap](#路线图) | [Development notes](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/blob/HEAD/docs/development.md) | [Report issues](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/issues) | [QQ discussion group 925687934](#反馈与参与)

The site is free to use. Generation, simulation, editing, saving, and export all happen in the browser, with no installation or registration required. With the same version, the same seed and parameters produce a bit-for-bit identical world on any device. A save file only records the seed, parameters, and edits, and is usually just a few KB.

## Features

### Planet generation

- **Spherical mesh**: spherical Poisson-disk sampling plus spherical Delaunay triangulation, with about 36,000 irregular cells by default, adjustable up to 200,000. The map wraps east–west and includes both poles, with no planar seams.
- **Plate tectonics**: plates of very different sizes move around Euler axes. Convergent boundaries build mountains, subduction zones form trenches, and divergent boundaries form mid-ocean ridges. Generates continents, microcontinents, island arcs, and polar continents.
- **River erosion**: stream power law, solved with the implicit method of Braun & Willett (2013). Priority-Flood fills depressions, and river networks and lakes are derived from drainage calculations.
- **Climate**: temperature is computed from latitude and elevation. The wind belts of the three-cell circulation carry moisture downwind, producing rain on windward slopes and rain shadows on leeward slopes.
- **Ocean currents**: warm currents, cold currents, and coastal upwelling are arranged according to ocean circulation patterns, modifying coastal temperature and precipitation.
- **Biomes**: divided into rainforest, grassland, desert, tundra, and others, by mean annual temperature and annual precipitation (Whittaker diagram).

### Historical simulation

- **Peoples and states**: peoples spread from their origin along habitable land, blocked by mountains, oceans, and deserts. Cities are founded, states are established and expanded, and wars and peace treaties, splits, mergers, restorations, and capital relocations occur.
- **Dynasties and figures**: dynastic succession and lineages. Every ruler and general has a biography (reign years, father and sons, predecessor and successor, personal campaigns, fate), and each dynasty has a family tree. Each dynasty also has several notable ministers who, like generals, have courtesy names, places of origin, offices, and a life story. Peace negotiations, regencies, and enthronements they take part in are recorded in the chronicle.
- **Social change**: assimilation and migration of peoples; rise and fall of cities (sacking, destruction, rebuilding, decline of former capitals); religions spread from great cities, become state religions, and split into sects.
- **Chronicle**: events from the simulation are written as Chinese-language annals. They can be filtered by state, and clicking an entry jumps to the corresponding year and location.

# ResolveAI — E-commerce Dual-Side and Multi-Agent Intelligent Customer Service Platform

ResolveAI is a runnable AI application. Customers register, log in, and chat directly with e-commerce customer service. They can also browse products, place orders, pay, and check logistics. Merchants manage products and all orders, and take over chats and after-sales issues that need human handling. The project uses LangGraph to orchestrate seven collaborating nodes, combining a mall database, a RAG knowledge base, and controlled tools to generate traceable replies.

The project is not connected to real payment, real logistics, or enterprise business channels, and does not handle real funds. Being runnable does not mean it has passed commercial production acceptance. Product facts come from merchant input, and the system does not treat model-generated content as business operations that have already been executed.

## Current Capabilities

- **Customer and merchant dual sides**: only two roles, customer and admin. After login, users enter chat or the back office respectively. Users can continue conversations, switch history, link their own orders, rate replies, and confirm resolution.
- **Mall and orders**: management of product name, images, description, category, price, and inventory; browsing, searching, sorting, placing orders, pending payment, paid, shipping, delivered, received, and transaction records. Amounts are stored as integer cents, the order price is snapshotted independently, and duplicate payments and inventory release have state and idempotency checks.
- **Chat and after-sales separated**: chat management shows all inquiries. After-sales handling focuses only on actual refunds, damage, or order exceptions, and does not automatically classify ordinary shopping, price inquiries, or proactive requests for a human as after-sales.
- **E-commerce customer service**: checks on-sale products, price comparison, detail follow-ups, inventory, the user's own order logistics, and merchant promotion FAQs. Ordinary replies are sent automatically. When information is insufficient, it asks for clarification first and does not fabricate ingredients, restock dates, or promotions.
- **Seven-node collaboration**: triage, knowledge retrieval, customer context, policy judgment, plan generation, quality inspection, and approval gating. Retrieval and context queries can run in parallel, and not all seven nodes call the LLM.
- **Knowledge base**: 21 general policy and SOP documents, supporting import, manual FAQs, document enable/disable, and source citations. Embeddings are configured independently of the generation model, and PostgreSQL uses pgvector for semantic retrieval.
- **Human boundaries**: refund and fund write operations, overdue logistics, explicit requests for a human, safety risks, and process exceptions enter the human queue. Conversations no longer auto-transfer to a human after more than five turns. Sessions taken over by a human are no longer continuously answered by the bot.
- **Feedback and status**: sending a reply does not mean it is resolved; a conversation closes only after customer confirmation. The back-office detail view shows customer ratings, comments, handling results, and times. Historical feedback is retained after follow-ups and re-analysis.

In the menu “Configuration & Updates…”, you can choose to use the system iCloud to remember the prompt style and automatic checks and re-apply patch preferences, and you can also export and import configuration. The WeChat path, whether this machine has previously been patched, login items, and system permissions are not migrated. Restoring a configuration does not authorize modifying WeChat on a new machine. The menu item “Check for Updates…” fetches new versions from this release channel on demand.

## First time? Follow the video step by step

**[Open the product homepage: direct download, installation guide, and demo video](https://unrevoke.tianli.cyou/)**. No GitHub account is needed; the installer and videos are served directly from the product site.

The in-repo tour uses an off-screen render of the v1.0.13 production main interface with simulated states. The version of the online tour is as labeled on the product page. [Recording and verification notes](https://github.com/zengtianli/WeChatUnrevoke/blob/HEAD/docs/demo/README.md).

## Leave the command line to the engine

When submitting feedback or compatibility records, please include the full WeChat version, build number, and installation channel. Original installers can be verified by SHA256. For field mapping and read-only extraction methods, see [WeChat version and installer verification](https://github.com/zengtianli/WeChatUnrevoke/blob/HEAD/docs/wechat-versions.md).

No need to look up build numbers manually or memorize patch commands. WeChatUnrevoke reads your WeChat status, tells you what it can do, and then hands the operations to the embedded [WeChatTweak engine](https://github.com/zengtianli/WeChatTweak). It suits Mac users who want to keep chat messages while checking and managing patches through a graphical interface.

| Keep messages and still know when they were recalled | Default “Keep notice”: in private chats, messages and recall notices are kept; in group chats, messages are kept but no notice is shown for now. |
